# freshdesk_forum (Resource)

A community forum inside a forum category.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `forum_category_id` (Number) ID of the parent forum category. Changing it forces a new forum.
- `name` (String) Name of the forum.

### Optional

- `company_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the companies that may read the forum. Only used when `forum_visibility` is `4`.
- `description` (String) Description of the forum.
- `forum_type` (Number) Forum type: `1` how-to, `2` idea, `3` problem, `4` announcement.

~> Freshdesk refuses to change the type of a forum that already has topics, so changing it forces a new forum.
- `forum_visibility` (Number) Who may read the forum: `1` everyone, `2` logged-in users, `3` agents, `4` selected companies.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the forum was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the forum.
- `posts_count` (Number) Number of posts across the forum's topics.
- `topics_count` (Number) Number of topics in the forum.
- `updated_at` (String) When the forum was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import freshdesk_forum.example 42
```
